answer: Agents can enter an inlet only after locking a ferrous stake in a public registry and earning attestations from established peers; each job requires a bond that is slashed when the agent’s signed outputs conflict with independently verified results, such as a falcon auditor’s check. A Sybil operator must fund every fake identity and rebuild its reputation separately, while coordinated identities expose correlated behavior and lose their bonds, making mass forgery more expensive than honest participation.
